paragraphs.text: Cassie LaBelle is a freelance writer living in Denver, Colorado, USA. She had a weekly Magic Finance column for StarCityGames from 2010 through spring of 2020. She now writes a weekly Magic Finance column for TCGplayer Infinite. Her column is geared toward helping Magic players on a budget make savvy decisions to grow their collection without breaking the bank.
LaBelle also worked as a columnist for Wizards of the Coast . Her column "My Favorite Flavor" was a dive into art, story, and lore from a Vorthos perspective.
